proposals.reason: Simple focus subject on a plain white background, sharp throughout. Whole fruit, and the first grapes.

fields.title: Red and Gold Grapes
fields.subject: fruit
fields.alt: A small bunch of grapes seen from above on plain white, some pale gold and some flushed rosy red, joined by thin brown stems, with a soft shadow beneath.
fields.prompt: Paint every grape as a round wash, gold first, and drop the red into the ones that blush.
fields.tip: Leave a tiny dot of paper on each grape for its shine before the colour goes on.

proposals.reason: One clear subject on a plain background, sharp throughout.
notes: Cadmium Yellow and Payne's Grey added by eye; the pixels read Chinese White, Ivory Black, Cadmium Orange and Burnt Sienna.

fields.title: Russet Pear
fields.subject: fruit
fields.alt: A single russet pear, orange speckled over yellow, with a curved dark stalk, standing on a black table against a plain pale lilac wall.
fields.prompt: Paint the pear yellow first, then speckle the orange over it while it is still damp.
fields.tip: Keep the table one flat dark wash and let the pear's edge stay crisp against it.

proposals.reason: One focus subject on a plain background, sharp. Crinkled petals and dry leaves to practise.
notes: Naples Yellow and Yellow Ochre added by eye; the pixels read Chinese White, Warm Grey, Ivory Black and Terre Verte.

fields.title: Dried Yellow Rose
fields.subject: botanical
fields.alt: A single dried yellow rose with crinkled, papery petals on a long thin stem with a few curled grey-green leaves, against a plain beige background.
fields.prompt: Dried petals are all edges. Paint the rose as one pale shape, then pick out a few folds.
fields.tip: Grey the leaves with a touch of their opposite so they read as dry, not fresh.

proposals.reason: One simple shape on a plain background, sharp. A quick warm-up.
notes: Palette chosen by eye: the pixels read Chinese White, Warm Grey and Naples Yellow, which is mostly the background.

fields.title: Pale Heart-Shaped Leaf
fields.subject: botanical
fields.alt: A single pale green heart-shaped leaf with fine veins, on a long thin curving stem, lying on a plain light grey background.
fields.prompt: One leaf, one stroke of stem. A good one to start cold on.
fields.tip: Paint the leaf very pale and wet, then draw the midrib in with the tip of the brush while it is damp.

fields.title: Pink Leaf on Teal
fields.subject: botanical
fields.alt: A single faded pink leaf with a pale stalk lying on cracked, dusty teal-green concrete, seen from directly above.
fields.prompt: Wash the teal ground first, leave a leaf-shaped gap, then fill it pink.
fields.tip: A little spatter on the dry ground wash is all the cracked concrete needs.

fields.title: Four Dried Stems
fields.subject: botanical

fields.prompt: Four stems, four strokes. Paint each one in a single movement from the base up.
fields.tip: The tape is a pale grey rectangle; leave it mostly paper.

fields.title: White Rose in Water
fields.subject: still-life
fields.alt: A single white rose with two small buds and a few serrated leaves, in a tall straight glass half full of water, against a plain pale grey wall.
fields.prompt: Leave the rose as paper and shape it with the grey around it.
fields.tip: Shift the stem slightly where it enters the water; that break is what makes it read as water.

proposals.reason: One focus subject, sharp, on a plain wall with a bold band of sunlight.

fields.title: Peach Rose in Sunlight
fields.subject: still-life
fields.alt: A single peach-pink rose on a long stem with glossy leaves, in a small clear glass bottle, lit by a diagonal band of sunlight across a dusty pink wall.
fields.prompt: Paint the wall's light and shadow first; the rose sits across the line between them.
fields.tip: Keep the stem inside the bottle a little paler than above it.

proposals.reason: Simple objects on a plain background, sharp. A lot of small florets to hold together, so it makes a stretch.

fields.title: Dried Hydrangeas in Wood
fields.subject: still-life
fields.alt: Two dried hydrangea heads, pale green-yellow with pink-edged florets, on long thin stems in a tall carved wooden vase, against a plain pale grey background.
fields.prompt: Paint each flower head as one round pale wash, then dab in a few pink edges.
fields.tip: Do not paint every floret: a scalloped edge and three or four inside are enough.

proposals.reason: Simple focus subject on a plain white background, sharp. White on white practice.

fields.title: Grass Heads in a Stoneware Vase
fields.subject: still-life
fields.alt: Two fluffy dried bunny-tail grass heads on thin stems in a cream stoneware vase with a round base, on crumpled linen against a plain white wall.
fields.prompt: White on white. Paint only the shadows, and let the two grass heads be the one warm note.
fields.tip: Keep the linen's folds to a few soft greys, painted wet so they blur.

fields.title: Two Glass Bottles on Teal
fields.subject: still-life
fields.alt: Two faceted glass bottles with ridged wooden stoppers standing apart on a golden wooden shelf, in the corner of two plain teal walls.
fields.prompt: Glass is mostly the colour behind it. Paint the teal and the gold, then the few darks.
fields.tip: Leave the highlights on the glass as bare paper from the start.

fields.title: Striped Brown Feather

fields.title: White Bauble
fields.subject: objects

fields.prompt: A white ball on white. Paint the shadow side and the cast shadow, and nothing else.

fields.title: Window to the Sea
fields.subject: objects
fields.alt: A low whitewashed wall with a square gap cut in its top, framing deep blue sea under a plain clear sky, above worn pale stone paving.
fields.prompt: Three bands: sky, wall and paving. The little square of sea is the only dark.
fields.tip: Paint the sky in one graded wash from deeper blue at the top to pale at the wall.

fields.title: Wall Lantern and Shadow
fields.subject: objects
fields.alt: A copper and glass wall lantern with a round filament bulb inside, on a cream wall in hard sunlight, casting a long dark shadow of itself below.
fields.prompt: The shadow is half the picture, so give it as much care as the lantern.
fields.tip: Paint the dark frame last, in thin strokes, over dry washes.
